name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. The facade provides complete per-method coverage with concrete omissions, fixed typed SDK reads/calculations, typed API operation schemas, guarded edits, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Public SDK observations are not native or saved-project proof. Schematic topology and dependent transactions are blocked because the installed netlist path can annotate and Save All; affected exports are refused. The reviewed external tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed. Current-generation disposable live validation is pending. Runtime identity and operation-specific evidence remain mandatory. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save are refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
